registration.answer: XML ActionRegisterTrigger is a no-op while registered; after full completion it is no longer registered and can be registered again. Lua can register multiple concurrent copies.

self_registration.answer: Direct self-registration from own actions may work; prefer ActionResetTrigger or ResetTrigger.
